title: test_kblane's check-lanes tests never reach the network inside a GitLab CI job
goal: TestCheckLanes removes every forge API variable kblane reads (CI_API_V4_URL, CI_PROJECT_ID, CI_JOB_TOKEN, GITHUB_API_URL, GITHUB_REPOSITORY, GITHUB_TOKEN, GITLAB_CI, GITHUB_ACTIONS) and replaces urllib's urlopen with a guard that fails the test, so test_an_api_error_exits_2_and_never_passes gets its 'missing CI_JOB_TOKEN' message in a GitLab job as it does locally, and a planted test shows the guard catching a real API call made with the CI variables set.
